neighbours.label: the token 'snow' (' snow' / 'Snow', Chinese/Japanese 雪) in any sense: weather, names (Snow White, Selangor 雪兰莪), 'to snow someone', TV static; snowy weather without the word stays quiet
neighbours.notes: Layer-0 token detector. Probes: 'snow' fires 0.5-0.85 across senses; flakes, blizzard, sleet, frost, German Schnee, Spanish nieve stay under 0.15; Snowden 0.15. Inverse search (globalMOO) found no leak; near-miss ceiling 0.07. Near misses swap only the snow word. Feeds the dummy-'it' unit L4/N9247- (step drop 0.10), presumably via 'it snowed'.
fire: Fresh snow covered the parking lot by morning.
We shoveled snow off the driveway before work.
The kids threw snow at each other after school.
The forecast calls for snow on Friday.
Snow White lived with seven dwarfs in the forest.
The salesman tried to snow us with jargon.
The mountain peaks were white with snow all year.
